We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: organized prostitution, management of prostitution venue, recruiting prostitutes, facilitating prostitution, etc. Chinese criminal law: "组织、强迫、容留、介绍他人卖淫" (Article 358). Also "为卖淫提供场所" (also under same article). The manager recruiting clients could be "组织卖淫" or "介绍卖淫". Also "帮助他人招揽嫖客" maybe "介绍卖淫". Also "收取提成" maybe "牟利". So crimes: "组织卖淫" (organizing prostitution) and "为卖淫提供场所" maybe same article. Also "招揽嫖客" could be "介绍卖淫". In Chinese law, "组织、强迫、容留、介绍他人卖淫" is one crime, but can be charged as "组织卖淫" or "介绍卖淫". The fact that they provided venue and managed, so "组织卖淫" is appropriate. Also "帮助他人招揽嫖客" is "介绍卖淫". Could be both. Also "非法经营" maybe not. So answer: [罪名]组织卖淫;介绍卖淫<eoa>
